pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_lab/components/shared/UserRating.tsx:100 A user-visible button label ships as a hardcoded English literal outside the catalog, while the next line uses t.agents.lab.saved_label. The standard puts 'literal escaping the catalog' in L1, which blocks, but here it reached the tree, so this context shows that class is not blocked.

techniques.evidence: src/features/agents/sub_lab/components/shared/UserRating.tsx:100 L1 requires 'no literal user-visible string escaping the catalog' to block. This literal landed in shipped code. A second L1 class is also present: LabResultModal.tsx:41 builds a heading from fragments, '{modeLabel} {t.agents.lab.results_suffix}', and LabEventStream.tsx:122 joins event_stream_failed + ': ' + a message in code.
